mapper.select: select u.id, u.account_name as accountName, u.avatar_url as avatarUrl, u.preferred_locale as preferredLocale, u.status, u.created_at as createdAt, u.updated_at as updatedAt, m.id as membershipId, m.plan_id as planId, m.tier as membershipTier, m.status as membershipStatus, m.started_at as membershipStartedAt, m.expires_at as membershipExpiresAt, s.mfa_enabled as mfaEnabled, s.mfa_method as mfaMethod, s.mfa_enabled_at as mfaEnabledAt, p.preferred_city_code as preferredCityCode, p.preferred_contact_channel as preferredContactChannel, p.staff_contact_enabled as staffContactEnabled, p.family_assist_enabled as familyAssistEnabled, p.introduction_updates_enabled as introductionUpdatesEnabled, p.event_reminders_enabled as eventRemindersEnabled, p.service_announcements_enabled as serviceAnnouncementsEnabled, p.marketing_emails_enabled as marketingEmailsEnabled, p.analytics_consent_enabled as analyticsConsentEnabled, (select count(1) from cm_auth_identities ai where ai.user_id = u.id) as identityCount, (select count(1) from cm_profiles cp join cm_profile_ownerships co on co.profile_id = cp.id and co.status = 'active' where co.user_id = u.id and cp.archived_at is null) as profileCount, (select count(1) from cm_profiles cp join cm_profile_ownerships co on co.profile_id = cp.id and co.status = 'active' where co.user_id = u.id and cp.profile_status = 'open' and cp.archived_at is null) as openProfileCount, (select count(1) from cm_event_registrations er where er.user_id = u.id) as eventRegistrationCount from cm_users u left join cm_user_memberships m on m.id = ( select um.id from cm_user_memberships um where um.user_id = u.id order by case when um.status = 'active' and (um.expires_at is null or um.expires_at > now()) then 0 else 1 end, case when um.tier != 'free' then 0 else 1 end, case um.tier when 'diamond' then 0 when 'gold' then 1 when 'silver' then 2 when 'free' then 3 else 4 end, um.started_at desc, um.created_at desc, um.id desc limit 1 ) left join cm_user_security_settings s on s.user_id = u.id left join cm_user_preferences p on p.user_id = u.id where u.id = #{id} limit 1

select p.id as profileId, p.profile_type as profileType, p.profile_status as profileStatus, p.birth_year as birthYear, p.city_code as cityCode, p.country_code as countryCode, p.updated_at as updatedAt, co.relationship_to_profile as relationshipToProfile, (select lf.value from cm_profile_localized_fields lf where lf.profile_id = p.id and lf.field_name = 'profile_name' and lf.locale = 'zh' limit 1) as profileName from cm_profiles p join cm_profile_ownerships co on co.profile_id = p.id and co.status = 'active' where co.user_id = #{userId} and p.archived_at is null order by case when p.profile_type = 'self' then 0 else 1 end, p.updated_at desc, p.id desc

select r.id as registrationId, r.event_id as eventId, r.status, r.requested_at as requestedAt, r.updated_at as updatedAt, e.event_date as eventDate, e.start_time as startTime, e.end_time as endTime, (select lf.value from cm_event_localized_fields lf where lf.event_id = e.id and lf.field_name = 'title' and lf.locale = 'zh' limit 1) as eventTitle from cm_event_registrations r join cm_events e on e.id = r.event_id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by coalesce(r.updated_at, r.requested_at) desc, r.id desc limit 5

select ai.id, ai.provider, ai.identifier, ai.verified_at as verifiedAt, ai.created_at as createdAt, case when ai.provider = 'email' and locate('@', ai.identifier) > 2 then concat(left(ai.identifier, 2), '***', substring(ai.identifier, locate('@', ai.identifier))) when ai.provider = 'phone' and length(ai.identifier) >= 7 then concat(left(ai.identifier, 3), '****', right(ai.identifier, 4)) else ai.identifier end as maskedIdentifier from cm_auth_identities ai where ai.user_id = #{userId} order by ai.created_at desc, ai.id desc

select p.id as profileId, p.profile_type as profileType, c.phone, c.email, c.wechat, c.preferred_channel as preferredChannel, c.visibility from cm_profile_contacts c join cm_profiles p on p.id = c.profile_id join cm_profile_ownerships o on o.profile_id = p.id and o.status = 'active' where o.user_id = #{userId} and p.archived_at is null order by case when p.profile_type = 'self' then 0 else 1 end, p.updated_at desc, p.id desc
mapper.update: update cm_users set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
